title: ACNH 1.0.0 UIMapSelectHandling to MapSelectPage/CharaMakeMap bounded trace

address_contract.important_limit: Native direct calls, raw vtable entries, and ELF relative relocations were checked. A dynamic/indirect relationship between the request manager and page code is not ruled out.

result.summary: The EventFlow UIMapSelectHandling record resolves to an action factory and callback path that submits request ID 42 with context through the singleton getter called with index 8. A separate MapSelectPage construction candidate stores a page object and a callback candidate reaches a CharaMakeMap layout consumer. No direct static call or relocation edge was found from the ID-42 request-manager path to that page/layout chain.
result.terrain_preset_boundary: SaveSetFromUIResult(cVillage) is an EventFlow result-save operation. This trace does not establish the selected terrain preset, map-card image generation, or the world-generation path.

proved_edges.detail: Parsed flow tree places these operations consecutively. EventFlowSystemActor action-array indices are 5 and 6 respectively; those indices are distinct from the flow-tree operation ordinals #0 and #1.

proved_edges.from: BindInfo.byml action name EventFlowActionUIMapSelectHandling, registration hash 0x1a24f4b5
proved_edges.to: main.elf VA 0x44cb30 factory via registration VA 0x3059bd8 and R_AARCH64_RELATIVE relocation at 0x3059be0
proved_edges.detail: Registration bytes at 0x3059bd8 are b5f4241a000000000000000000000000; the relocation addend resolves to 0x44cb30. The exact BindInfo entry has no alias. Factory allocates 0xc0 bytes and BLs 0x356e90 at PC 0x44cb54.

proved_edges.to: action vtable address point 0x304e3e0; slot 14 at 0x304e450 targets 0x356f10
proved_edges.detail: At PC 0x356eb0 the constructor stores the vptr. Vtable pointer source cell 0x32dd640 resolves to base 0x304e3d0, then constructor adds 0x10. Method 0x356f10 stores immediate 0x2a at action-object offset +0xb8 (PC 0x356f14), so the action callback's request ID is 42.
PC 0x34b710 loads vtable slot +0x70 and PC 0x34b718 invokes it; the callback then reads request ID from self+0xb8, obtains context, and tail-branches at PC 0x34b74c.

proved_edges.to: singleton getter 0x15411b0 with argument 8, then manager candidate method 0x11eca30
proved_edges.detail: PC 0x158ff74 sets index 8 and PC 0x158ff7c calls the singleton getter. On the active service branch, PC 0x1590004 passes the action ID, PC 0x1590008 passes context, and PC 0x159001c branches to 0x11eca30. This proves a shared index-8 request/result state path; its semantic class name is unresolved.

The entry checks field +0x21c against -1. If free, its adjacent request path at 0x11eca44 stores the passed ID at +0x21c at PC 0x11eca6c, writes a status byte at +0x220, and clears +0x224 at PC 0x11eca88. This supports an active-request slot interpretation, without resolving the manager's public name.

0x34b760 directly calls 0x1590180; that helper requests singleton index 8 and calls 0x11ecbd0, which reads manager fields +0x21c and +0x228. The companion path reaches 0x15903c0, which also requests singleton index 8. These are request-state/result polling/service paths; exact external operation names remain unresolved.

proved_edges.from: function 0x12424c0 materializes string MapSelectPage at VA 0x29a2521
proved_edges.to: creator candidate 0x1242550 at direct-call PC 0x124252c; result stored at object +0x210 at PC 0x1242530
proved_edges.detail: The caller passes the MapSelectPage string and helper data in stack arguments. Creator candidate allocates 0x5c0 bytes and calls 0x12406d0 at PC 0x1242604, then attachment/initialization helpers 0x1da8210, 0x1144600, and 0x1da8220. Constructor vptr source cell 0x3307b48 resolves to vtable base 0x3110b28 and address point 0x3110b38.

Function 0x1242fa0 tests page-object field +0x218 and directly calls 0x1243980 at PC 0x1242fc8. This pointer cell is separate from the page vtable: page vtable slot 14 at 0x3110ba8 resolves to 0x1da5680, while cell 0x3307bb8 resolves to 0x1242fa0. The cell's consumer/call site is unresolved.

proved_edges.from: function 0x1243980, with string CharaMakeMap at VA 0x294cbc3
proved_edges.detail: The code reads page-object fields +0x210, nested +0x3f8 and +0x218. At PCs 0x12439ec/0x1243a08 it supplies the CharaMakeMap string to the direct call at 0x1243a0c (target 0xb1aa20), with adjacent resource/layout setup and completion helpers. This is a strong string-and-call candidate for a CharaMakeMap BFLYT consumer, not a proved runtime binding to the EventFlow action.

no_proven_connection.finding: The indexed direct-call graph contains no edge from 0x158ff60, 0x11eca30, 0x1590180, or 0x15903c0 to 0x1242550, 0x1242fa0, or 0x1243980. A relocation points to 0x1242fa0, but its runtime consumer was not identified. No direct static call or relocation proves that the index-8 request manager creates MapSelectPage, invokes CharaMakeMap, populates card captures, or selects a terrain preset.
no_proven_connection.limit: Generic indirect calls/manager callbacks may connect the systems dynamically. The static trace does not identify such an edge and must not be read as proof that the systems are unrelated.

asset_observations.evidence: [ASSET] parsed BFLYT/BFLAN/BNTX metadata from the listed source archives

layouts.observation: Contains four reusable part panes L_Btn_00 through L_Btn_03 referencing LCharaMakeMapBtn, plus L_Dialog_00.
Contains N_Capture_00 sized 390x390, nested part L_MapChoice_00 referencing LMapChoice, and P_Capture_00.

P_Map_00 uses material index 0, whose texture index 0 is Capture^t. P_Material_00 uses Noise^r. The same-source BNTX container SHA256 is 6cc500513685c399c42dc3ec3cdf8f68c8a2611aa76af3afeb3bd203da2648b9; Capture^t metadata is BC5_UNORM 8x8, one mip, 512-byte image. The existence/name of this texture is proved; whether runtime replaces or renders into it is not.

conversion_and_provenance_implications: The static layout records establish reusable map-card structure and named texture bindings, but do not provide evidence for the pixels or runtime update path of map thumbnails. A layout-only conversion cannot establish dynamic card capture behavior.

Keep source .zs archive hashes and extracted BFLYT/BFLAN/BNTX member hashes with any converted asset set. Capture^t is present as an 8x8 BNTX texture; avoid treating its name alone as proof that it is a live render target.
Decoded animation tags, targets, and frame/key structure are evidence of resource data only; runtime trigger order and selected-card semantics are unresolved.
